housing.summary: Average 1-bedroom apartment in Gatineau city centre is approximately CAD 1,545/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Quebec landlords may require 1 month security deposit, though Quebec law limits deposits to first month's rent only. Kijiji.ca and rentals.ca are primary rental portals.

banking.summary: Major Canadian banks serve Gatineau (across the Ottawa River from Ottawa). Newcomers need passport, immigration document, proof of Quebec address, and SIN if available. RBC and TD Bank both offer bilingual (French/English) newcomer banking services in the region.
required_docs: Immigration document (work permit, study permit, or PR card)

schools.summary: Gatineau is served by the Commission scolaire des Draveurs and Commission scolaire au Coeur-des-Vallees for French-language public schools, and the Western Quebec School Board for English-language public education. French is the language of instruction. Newcomers with children may need to meet Quebec language law requirements for school enrollment.
curricula: English-language instruction via Western Quebec School Board for eligible students

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers on work or study permits must notify IRCC of address changes via the IRCC portal. Permanent residents update SIN address with Service Canada. Quebec drivers must exchange a foreign driving licence within 90 days of establishing Quebec residency via SAAQ.
legal_admin.registration_step: Update address with IRCC at ircc.canada.ca if on work/study permit; permanent residents update SIN address at Service Canada.

tax_finance.summary: A Social Insurance Number (SIN) is Canada's tax identification number, issued by Service Canada. Quebec residents also file provincial taxes with Revenu Quebec. SIN required for work, federal and provincial tax filing, and government benefits.

transport.summary: Gatineau is served by the STO (Societe de transport de l'Outaouais). Numbeo reports an average monthly transit pass of CAD 113 for Gatineau. The STO also connects to Ottawa's OC Transpo network. Foreign licence holders must exchange to a Quebec licence within 90 days via SAAQ. Quebec's RAMQ (Regie de l'assurance maladie du Quebec) health insurance has a 3-month waiting period for new residents from outside Canada.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Foreign licence holders must exchange to a Quebec licence within 90 days of establishing Quebec residency. Apply at a SAAQ (Societe de l'assurance automobile du Quebec) service centre (saaq.gouv.qc.ca).
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for RAMQ (Quebec Health Insurance) through the Regie de l'assurance maladie du Quebec (ramq.gouv.qc.ca). New residents from outside Canada typically face a 3-month waiting period before coverage begins. Get private health insurance during the wait period.
